d: The Dermatology Nurse is responsible for providing comprehensive nursing care to patients with skin, hair, and nail conditions. The role involves assisting dermatologists during consultations and procedures, performing dermatological nursing treatments, preparing patients, maintaining infection control standards, and ensuring high-quality, safe, and patient-centered care.
q: Bachelor's Degree with valid nursing license from the relevant regulatory authority.
4 years of clinical nursing experience; dermatology experience is preferred.
Good knowledge of infection prevention and control.
Strong communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.
r: Assess patients' general condition and dermatological concerns.
Obtain and document vital signs and relevant medical history.
Prepare patients for dermatology consultations and procedures.
Provide pre- and post-procedure nursing care.
Monitor patients for adverse reactions or complications.
Educate patients regarding skin conditions, medications, and treatment plans.
Assist dermatologists during minor surgical and dermatological procedures.
Prepare treatment rooms, instruments, and medical supplies.
Assist with skin biopsies, cryotherapy, electrocautery, wound care, and other dermatological procedures within the nurse's scope of practice.
Perform prescribed wound dressings and skin care treatments.
Assist with laser and aesthetic dermatology procedures when appropriately trained and authorized.
Ensure proper handling and disposal of clinical waste and sharps.
Administer prescribed medications and treatments according to physician orders.
Assist with topical treatments, injections, and other prescribed therapies within the scope of nursing practice.
Monitor patients for medication side effects and allergic reactions.
Maintain accurate medication and treatment records.

d: We are seeking a commercially driven and highly connected Sales & Vendor Partnerships Lead to identify, source, attract and secure high-quality vendors and business partners for our premium retail, dining and entertainment offerings.

The successful candidate will be responsible for researching and developing relationships with established Saudi businesses, emerging entrepreneurs, independent brands, artisans and speciality retailers.
A key objective of this position is to champion Saudi entrepreneurship, showcase local craftsmanship and provide a platform for homegrown brands to reach a premium audience.

The role requires a strong combination of business development, market research, sales, vendor procurement and commercial negotiation skills. The candidate will be responsible for managing the entire vendor acquisition process, from identifying potential businesses and assessing their suitability to negotiating commercial agreements and coordinating onboarding.
q: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Sales, Marketing, Hospitality or a related field preferred.
4–6 years of experience in sales, business development, commercial leasing, retail partnerships or vendor acquisition.
Proven experience sourcing and securing business partnerships, vendors or commercial tenants.
Strong knowledge of the Saudi retail, lifestyle, F&B and entrepreneurial landscape.
An established network of contacts within the Saudi business community would be highly advantageous.
Experience working with premium, luxury or lifestyle brands is preferred.
Strong commercial negotiation, presentation and relationship-building skills.
Excellent research, analytical and organisational capabilities.
Ability to independently manage a sales pipeline and deliver against commercial targets.
Fluent English; Arabic is highly preferred.

d: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
The role of a Silicon Alliances Ecosystem Development Manager at Canonical
Ubuntu is the fastest growing enterprise Linux, the leading platform for public cloud computing, and the engineer's favorite way to drive the future.

Our goal is to help the enterprise embrace open source from end to end, across every class of compute and every class of application, starting with the linux kernel itself, to infrastructure solutions like OpenStack and Kubernetes, all the way up to data, security, analytics and serverless capabilities.

The Silicon Alliances Team works with the leading semiconductor companies to combine open source adoption with innovative optimizations to get the most from each new chip. With our semiconductor partners, we develop joint product roadmaps, drive delivery, formulate go-to-market plans and conceptualize new business models, enabling differentiated hardware and robust product life-cycle support while still anchored to best-in-class Ubuntu. The end goal is a frictionless experience to deploy, maintain, and develop on any hardware from cloud to edge.

The successful candidate is someone who is passionate about both hardware and software technology with interest to grow into business development. We are hiring for positions across early career to senior roles, with scope ranging from small exploratory partnerships to managing our largest and most strategic partnerships.
If you are someone who can navigate complex new technical challenges, learn quickly, and architect solutions and strategies across global teams, this challenging role is for you.

Location: We are hiring for remote roles in Americas. We will also consider applicants in EMEA who can accommodate a shifted schedule to support Silicon partners in Americas. Global travel to sprints, events, and partner meetings is part of the role.
What your day will look like
Represent Canonical, its solutions and software to partners.
Develop a deep understanding of silicon partner strategies, technologies and roadmaps and identify overlap with Canonical’s current and future products.

Work cross-functionally with engineering, product, marketing and sales teams to facilitate new business, leading definition of joint products, solutions and complex programs relying heavily on your communicating and influencing skills.
Ensure that robust project plans are created, tracked, and executed.
Develop joint Go To Market strategy and campaigns with silicon partners, manage market messaging, collateral and launch plans across products.
What we are looking for in you
B.A / B.S / B.E degree in science, technology and/or engineering.
Fundamental understanding of the semiconductor industry and ecosystem.
Experience in software and system architecture is preferred.
Customer-facing experience in business development, technology strategy or similar functions.
Excellent communication skills; ability to grasp complex material and synthesize key points.
Ability to think and work at both strategic and tactical levels
Disciplined and self motivated for a remote-first workplace environment.
q: Experience with open source software and open source business models is preferred.
Team leadership or program management experience.

Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
